en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a richly decorated Gothic Revival hall with high ribbed vaults and ornate painted patterns on the ribs and walls. The room features carved wooden chairs and tables, arched doorways with tracery, wall paintings of castles and landscapes, and a wooden niche or altar-like structure with statues along one wall. The photograph has a narrow black border like an old postcard and some handwritten notation along the right edge.
